question: How many items of clothing do I need to pick up or return from a store?
first_use_boundary: First actual downstream use of the count, an external action relying on it, or final delivered answer. Undelivered drafts do not automatically count; no retrospective draft relabeling.
necessary_conditions: Interpret the question at its supplied question_date, using reported outstanding actions; do not invent later completion.
Count distinct pending store-related items rather than mentions or the number of individual shoes in a pair.
The source-based expected count is two: one blazer and one pair of exchanged boots.
If explanations identify items/actions, do not double-count the boots, treat the planned blazer pickup as completed, or include the sweater loan or laundry as store errands.
scope_assumptions: A pair of boots is one clothing item for this task.
Dry-cleaning collection is included in the question’s store-related pickup scope.
Absence of a completion report is not proof of real-world non-completion; conclusions are bounded to the supplied archive.

source_assertions.statement: The navy blue blazer was reported awaiting dry-cleaning pickup; a later intention to go is not confirmation of completion.
The exchanged Zara boots are one outstanding pair to collect; the two mentions describe the same purchase/exchange rather than two separate outstanding items.
The green sweater is with the sister, not a store pickup or return.
The black jeans and white shirt are described as recent purchases, without an outstanding store action in these reports.
Washing yoga pants is a laundry task, not a store pickup or return.
